function.name: glob
function.description: Find files by name pattern (e.g. **/*.py). Prefer over bash find/ls. Skips .git, node_modules, __pycache__, virtualenvs, and cache directories.

pattern.description: Glob pattern with *, **, and ? support. Matches the whole relative path or the file name.

path.description: Optional subdirectory relative to the workspace. Default: workspace root.
